human_decision.definition: Identify the declared instrument domain. Policy separately checks current affected-service relevance. Missing or ambiguous declarations establish no domain.

comparison: Same normalized report texts, reading question, model and metadata policy. Hosted arms change domain instructions and criteria together. Software-domain controls replace only domain with a valid supplied declaration; reading predictions remain identical.
response_reuse: One actual response per distinct text/reader, reused across correlated occurrences and paired packets. Software-domain paths make no model calls.
software_assumption: Structured declarations match the explicit report header in this synthetic pack. Neither correctness nor operational trust of declarations is validated.

narrow.input_scope: Observation detail only; asset identities normalized. No impact, paths, timestamps, policy text or packet target decisions.

broad.input_scope: Observation detail only; asset identities normalized. No impact, paths, timestamps, policy text or packet target decisions.

arms.narrow_fact: Report ML · original phrases + declared domain in software
arms.broad_fact: Report ML · broader phrases + declared domain in software
arms.report_rules_fact: Report rules → policy + declared domain in software

metrics.limitations: Synthetic policy benchmark. Repeated family realizations are not independent incidents. No production benefit is measured.
metrics.software_priority_note: Separate counterfactual score: keep the three model decisions and replace priority using the published policy. Original predictions are unchanged; failed responses remain failures.
